## Creating plots for Figure S7E

Correct H3K27me3 measurements; correct linkage with gene.

V3: Invert plot axes and coloring
Goal : create scatterplot with y h3k4me3, x H3K27me3 and the colour the gene expression


```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(GenomicRanges)
```

# Read global information

## Promoters

```{r promoters}
gene_bed <- read.table("/Users/maxim/Documents/RNAseq_2i_to_EpiLC/mm10_TSS_1kb.bed5", header = TRUE)
## Remove duplicates (no associated name, multiple IDs)
gene_bed <- gene_bed |>
  filter(!is.na(name)) |>
  select(chr:name) |> distinct()

gr_gene_bed <- GRanges(
  seqnames = gene_bed$chr,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = gene_bed$start, end = gene_bed$end),
  Gene = gene_bed$name)
```

# Functions

## H3K27me3 - Hist

```{r fn-overlap-h3k27me3-mark2}
get_overlap_H3K27me3_mark2 <- function(H3K27me3, mark2, mark2_name) {
  logfc_col <- paste0("LogFC_", mark2_name)

  gr_H3K27me3 <- GRanges(
    seqnames = H3K27me3$seqname,
    ranges   = IRanges(start = H3K27me3$start, end = H3K27me3$end),
    LogFC_H3K27me3 = H3K27me3$LogFC_H3K27me3,
    direction = H3K27me3$direction)

  gr_mark2 <- GRanges(
    seqnames = mark2$seqname,
    ranges   = IRanges(start = mark2$start, end = mark2$end))
  mcols(gr_mark2) <- setNames(data.frame(mark2[[logfc_col]], mark2$direction),
                              c(logfc_col, "direction"))

  hits          <- findOverlaps(gr_mark2, gr_H3K27me3)

  overlaps      <- pintersect(gr_mark2[queryHits(hits)], gr_H3K27me3[subjectHits(hits)])
  overlap_width <- width(overlaps)
  frac_mark2    <- overlap_width / width(gr_mark2)[queryHits(hits)]
  frac_H3K27me3 <- overlap_width / width(gr_H3K27me3)[subjectHits(hits)]

  df_mark2 <- as.data.frame(gr_mark2)[queryHits(hits), ] %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, ".", mark2_name), .cols = c(seqnames, start, end, width, strand, direction))

  df_H3K27me3 <- as.data.frame(gr_H3K27me3)[subjectHits(hits), ] %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, ".H3K27me3"), .cols = c(seqnames, start, end, width, strand, direction))

  frac_mark2_col <- paste0("frac_", mark2_name)
  result <- cbind(df_mark2,
                  df_H3K27me3,
                  setNames(data.frame(overlap_width, frac_mark2, frac_H3K27me3),
                           c("overlap_width", frac_mark2_col, "frac_H3K27me3")))

  seqnames_mark2_col <- paste0("seqnames.", mark2_name)
  start_mark2_col    <- paste0("start.", mark2_name)
  end_mark2_col      <- paste0("end.", mark2_name)

  result <- result %>%
    group_by(.data[[seqnames_mark2_col]], .data[[start_mark2_col]], .data[[end_mark2_col]]) %>%
    filter(.data[[frac_mark2_col]] == max(.data[[frac_mark2_col]])) %>% ## Keep highest coverage of mark2 region
    ungroup()

  direction_mark2_col <- paste0("direction.", mark2_name)
  result <- result %>% mutate(direction.both = case_when(
    .data[[direction_mark2_col]] != "none" & direction.H3K27me3 != "none" ~ "Both",
    .data[[direction_mark2_col]] != "none" & direction.H3K27me3 == "none" ~ mark2_name,
    .data[[direction_mark2_col]] == "none" & direction.H3K27me3 != "none" ~ "H3K27me3",
    TRUE                                                                  ~ "None"),
    direction.both = factor(direction.both, levels = c("H3K27me3", mark2_name, "Both", "None")))

  result
}
```


## H3K27me3-Hist - Promoter

```{r fn-overlap-mark2-promoter}
get_overlap_mark2_promoter <- function(overlap_result, mark2_name) {
  seqnames_mark2_col <- paste0("seqnames.", mark2_name)
  start_mark2_col    <- paste0("start.", mark2_name)
  end_mark2_col      <- paste0("end.", mark2_name)

  ## This function uses the coordinates of the mark2 peak as anchor
  gr.K27me3.mark2 <- GRanges(seqnames = overlap_result[[seqnames_mark2_col]],
                             ranges   = IRanges(start = overlap_result[[start_mark2_col]], end = overlap_result[[end_mark2_col]]))
  mcols(gr.K27me3.mark2) <- overlap_result

  gr.H3K27me3 <- GRanges(seqnames = overlap_result$seqnames.H3K27me3,
                         ranges   = IRanges(start = overlap_result$start.H3K27me3, end = overlap_result$end.H3K27me3))

  hits <- findOverlaps(gr.K27me3.mark2, gr_gene_bed)

  overlaps_promoter      <- pintersect(gr.K27me3.mark2[queryHits(hits)], gr_gene_bed[subjectHits(hits)])
  overlap_width_promoter <- width(overlaps_promoter)
  frac_promoter          <- overlap_width_promoter/width(gr_gene_bed)[subjectHits(hits)]

  ## Ensure the promoter overlaps with the H3K27me3 peak
  overlaps_H3K27me3_promoter      <- pintersect(gr.H3K27me3[queryHits(hits)], gr_gene_bed[subjectHits(hits)])
  overlap_width_H3K27me3_promoter <- width(overlaps_H3K27me3_promoter)
  frac_H3K27me3_promoter          <- overlap_width_H3K27me3_promoter/width(gr_gene_bed)[subjectHits(hits)]

  result <- cbind(
    as.data.frame(gr.K27me3.mark2)[queryHits(hits),],
    as.data.frame(gr_gene_bed)[subjectHits(hits),] %>%
      dplyr::select(seqnames.Prom = seqnames, start.Prom = start, end.Prom = end, Gene),
    overlap_width_promoter = overlap_width_promoter,
    frac_promoter = frac_promoter,
    overlap_width_H3K27me3_promoter = overlap_width_H3K27me3_promoter,
    frac_H3K27me3_promoter = frac_H3K27me3_promoter)

  result <- result %>%
    filter(overlap_width_H3K27me3_promoter > 0) %>%
    group_by(seqnames, start, end) %>%
    filter(frac_promoter == max(frac_promoter)) %>% ## Keep the promoter with the maximum overlap
    filter(frac_H3K27me3_promoter == max(frac_H3K27me3_promoter)) %>%
    ungroup()

  result
}
```

## Print number of dots per quadrant

```{r fn-quadrants}
quadrants <- function(data, x.axis, y.axis) {
  result <- data %>%
    filter({{ x.axis }} != 0, {{ y.axis }} != 0) %>%
    mutate(result = case_when(
      {{ x.axis }} < 0 & {{ y.axis }} > 0 ~ "haut gauche",
      {{ x.axis }} < 0 & {{ y.axis }} < 0 ~ "bas gauche",
      {{ x.axis }} > 0 & {{ y.axis }} > 0 ~ "haut droite",
      {{ x.axis }} > 0 & {{ y.axis }} < 0 ~ "bas droite"),
      result = factor(result, levels = c("haut gauche", "bas gauche", "haut droite", "bas droite"))) %>%
    count(result) %>%
    mutate(proportion = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2))

  result
}
```

```{r}
quadrants_RNA <- function(data, x.axis, y.axis, direction) {
  Gene_quad <- data %>%
    filter({{ x.axis }} != 0, {{ y.axis }} != 0) %>%
    #filter({{ direction }} %in% c("UP", "DOWN")) %>%   ## keep DE genes only (drop "NS")
    mutate(
      result = case_when(
        {{ x.axis }} < 0 & {{ y.axis }} > 0 ~ "haut gauche",
        {{ x.axis }} < 0 & {{ y.axis }} < 0 ~ "bas gauche",
        {{ x.axis }} > 0 & {{ y.axis }} > 0 ~ "haut droite",
        {{ x.axis }} > 0 & {{ y.axis }} < 0 ~ "bas droite"),
      result = factor(result, levels = c("haut gauche", "bas gauche", "haut droite", "bas droite")),
      {{ direction }} := factor({{ direction }}, levels = c("NS", "UP", "DOWN"))) %>%
    select(Gene, {{ direction }}, result) %>% distinct() %>% ## Remove enhancers/promoters with the same quadrant and target gene
    count(result, {{ direction }}, .drop = FALSE) %>%   ## number of NS / UP / DOWN genes per quadrant
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = {{ direction }}, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)   ## one row per quadrant, columns NS / UP / DOWN
  
  Gene_quad
}
```

# WT_K4M vs WT_H3

## Read tables of histone marks

### H3K4me3

```{r wt-k4m-h3-h3k4me3}
df_H3K4me3_all <- read.table("/Users/maxim/Documents/MATAC_analysis/DiffBind_result/scatterplot_H3K27me3_H3K4me3/H3K4me3_all_D2_H3_WT_vs_D2_K4M_WT.bed", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
df_H3K4me3_all <- dplyr::rename(df_H3K4me3_all, seqname = Chr, start = Start, end = End, LogFC_H3K4me3 = Fold)
## Check contrast (most should lose H3K4me3)
sum(df_H3K4me3_all$LogFC_H3K4me3 > 0)
sum(df_H3K4me3_all$LogFC_H3K4me3 < 0)
## Mark DE
df_H3K4me3_all <- df_H3K4me3_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K4me3 > 1  ~ "up",
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K4me3 < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                            ~ "none"))
table(df_H3K4me3_all$direction)
```

### H3K27me3

```{r wt-k4m-h3-h3k27me3}
df_H3K27me3_all <- read.table("/Users/maxim/Documents/Marlet/Results/H3K27me3/D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_WT_K4M_H3K27me3_spikeIn.txt", header = TRUE, sep = '\t')
## Mark DE
df_H3K27me3_all <- dplyr::rename(df_H3K27me3_all, LogFC_H3K27me3 = log2FoldChange)
df_H3K27me3_all <- df_H3K27me3_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  padj < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K27me3 > 1  ~ "up",
  padj < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K27me3 < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                            ~ "none"))
table(df_H3K27me3_all$direction)
## Extract coordinates
df_H3K27me3_all <- df_H3K27me3_all %>% mutate(
  seqname = str_extract(coord, "^[^:]+"),
  start= as.integer(str_extract(coord, "(?<=:)\\d+")),
  end= as.integer(str_extract(coord,"(?<=-)[\\d]+$")))
```

## Combine H3K4me1/3 with H3K27me3

```{r wt-k4m-h3-combine}
result_H3K4me3_H3K27me3 <- get_overlap_H3K27me3_mark2(H3K27me3 = df_H3K27me3_all, mark2 = df_H3K4me3_all, mark2_name = "H3K4me3")
## Intersect H3K4me3-H3K27me3 with promoters
result_H3K4me3_H3K27me3_promoter <- get_overlap_mark2_promoter(result_H3K4me3_H3K27me3, mark2_name = "H3K4me3")

rm(result_H3K4me3_H3K27me3)
```

## Import limma results and merge

```{r}
clean_NoDiff <- function(df, colname) {
  df[[colname]][df[[colname]] == "NaN"] <- "n.s."
  return(df)
}
```

```{r wt-k4m-h3-rna}
df_RNA <- read.table("/Users/maxim/Documents/RNAseq_2i_to_EpiLC/RNAseq_data_Angelique/H3K4M_RNAseq_RPKM_without_dup_WT.H3K4M.D2_vs_WT.H3.D2.txt", header = TRUE)
## Clean table (remove condition tags)
colnames(df_RNA) <- str_remove(colnames(df_RNA), "_[[:alnum:].]+_vs_[[:alnum:].]+$")
df_RNA <- df_RNA %>% dplyr::rename(LogFC_RNA = logFC)
## Clean DE tags
df_RNA$thresh_adjp005_fc1 <- str_remove(df_RNA$thresh_adjp005_fc1, "_[[:alnum:].]+_vs_[[:alnum:].]+$")
df_RNA <- clean_NoDiff(df_RNA, "thresh_adjp005_fc1")

## Add RNAseq information; drop non-quantified genes
## Promoters
result_H3K4me3_H3K27me3_promoter <- result_H3K4me3_H3K27me3_promoter %>%
  left_join(df_RNA, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(LogFC_RNA))
```

# TKO_K4M vs WT_K4M

## Read tables of histone marks

### H3K4me3

```{r tko-k4m-wt-k4m-h3k4me3}
df_H3K4me3_all <- read.table("/Users/maxim/Documents/MATAC_analysis/DiffBind_result/scatterplot_H3K27me3_H3K4me3/H3K4me3_all_D2_K4M_WT_vs_K4M_TKO.bed", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
df_H3K4me3_all <- dplyr::rename(df_H3K4me3_all, seqname = Chr, start = Start, end = End, LogFC_H3K4me3 = Fold)
## Check contrast (most should lose H3K4me3)
sum(df_H3K4me3_all$LogFC_H3K4me3 > 0)
sum(df_H3K4me3_all$LogFC_H3K4me3 < 0)
## Mark DE
df_H3K4me3_all <- df_H3K4me3_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K4me3 > 1  ~ "up",
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K4me3 < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                            ~ "none"))
table(df_H3K4me3_all$direction)
```

### H3K27me3

```{r tko-k4m-wt-k4m-h3k27me3}
df_H3K27me3_all <- read.table("/Users/maxim/Documents/Marlet/Results/H3K27me3/D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_K4M_H3K27me3_spikeIn.txt", header = TRUE, sep = '\t')
## Mark DE
df_H3K27me3_all <- dplyr::rename(df_H3K27me3_all, LogFC_H3K27me3 = log2FoldChange)
df_H3K27me3_all <- df_H3K27me3_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  padj < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K27me3 > 1  ~ "up",
  padj < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K27me3 < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                            ~ "none"))
table(df_H3K27me3_all$direction)
## Extract coordinates
df_H3K27me3_all <- df_H3K27me3_all %>% mutate(
  seqname = str_extract(coord, "^[^:]+"),
  start= as.integer(str_extract(coord, "(?<=:)\\d+")),
  end= as.integer(str_extract(coord,"(?<=-)[\\d]+$")))
```

## Combine H3K4me1/3 with H3K27me3

```{r tko-k4m-wt-k4m-combine}
result_H3K4me3_H3K27me3 <- get_overlap_H3K27me3_mark2(H3K27me3 = df_H3K27me3_all, mark2 = df_H3K4me3_all, mark2_name = "H3K4me3")
## Intersect H3K4me3-H3K27me3 with promoters
result_H3K4me3_H3K27me3_promoter <- get_overlap_mark2_promoter(result_H3K4me3_H3K27me3, mark2_name = "H3K4me3")

rm(result_H3K4me3_H3K27me3)
```

## Import limma results and merge

```{r tko-k4m-wt-k4m-rna}
df_RNA <- read.table("/Users/maxim/Documents/RNAseq_2i_to_EpiLC/RNAseq_data_Angelique/H3K4M_RNAseq_RPKM_without_dup_TKO.H3K4M.D2_vs_WT.H3K4M.D2.txt", header = TRUE)

df_RNA <- df_RNA %>% dplyr::rename(LogFC_RNA = logFC)
## Clean DE tags
df_RNA$thresh_adjp005_fc1 <- str_remove(df_RNA$thresh_adjp005_fc1, "_[[:alnum:].]+_vs_[[:alnum:].]+$")
df_RNA <- clean_NoDiff(df_RNA, "thresh_adjp005_fc1")


## Promoters
```
